title: A 16-Year-Old Guitar Hero From Thailand Just Won America's Got Talent!
summary:
Imagine standing on a huge stage in America for the very first time. Your hands are shaking. You're holding an electric guitar. Then you start to play — and the whole crowd jumps to their feet!

That's exactly what happened to Nene Royal. She's a 16-year-old girl from Thailand. When she tried out for America's Got Talent, she played a heavy, rocking version of the song "Zombie." People loved it so much that the video got 21 million views!

Nene kept blowing everyone away all season. She rocked songs by Soundgarden, Muse, and the White Stripes. In the finale, she even sang with Linkin Park.

Then came the big moment. Host Terry Crews called her name — she won! Nene says she was so shocked she almost fainted. She took home one million dollars and became the first Thai winner ever on the show.

Nene started playing guitar when she was just seven years old in Phuket, Thailand. Her dad doesn't play music at all, but he always drove her to lessons and cheered her on. You can even see him rocking out in the audience during her first audition.

What's next for this rock star? She wants to make a rock album, go on tour, and take her band to Disneyland. "Or sleep," she says with a laugh. Sounds like a plan!
why_it_matters: It shows that starting small — like a seven-year-old taking guitar lessons — and having people who cheer you on can lead to something huge.
